description: Na₄TiO(PO₄)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmme space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.46 Å) and four longer (2.91 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.42 Å) and four longer (2.89 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.52 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 43°. There are two shorter (1.91 Å) and four longer (2.00 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 42°. There are two shorter (1.53 Å) and two longer (1.58 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ti atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂Ti₂ tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom.
